reason: A persistent DeepSeek Harness web plugin that retrieves account balance data through a host-side API route and displays it beneath the conversation composer with periodic refreshes.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话输入框下方持续显示账户余额，并通过主机端接口定时或手动从 DeepSeek 获取最新余额。
summaries.en: A persistent DeepSeek Harness plugin that displays account balance beneath the conversation composer and retrieves updated data periodically or on demand through a host-side API route.

capabilities: Reads the configured DEEPSEEK_API_KEY through the host credential system
Calls the DeepSeek account balance API
Displays balance data in a persistent composer status bar
Refreshes balance data every 60 seconds and on manual request
